name: Country
definition: 具有明确地理边界与主权管辖范围的政治实体，是联赛与比赛举办地的上位地域单元。 Counterexample: 与'地区/城市'混淆：后者是主权国家内部的次级行政单元，不具备主权属性。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Country; provenance: direct source Country

name: League
definition: 由特定国家或地区组织、按赛季周期性举办并由多支球队参加的竞技赛事组织单元。 Counterexample: 与'杯赛/锦标赛'混淆：后者多为淘汰制短期赛事，而非按赛季循环的联赛组织。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table League; provenance: direct source League

name: Match
definition: 在特定日期于某一联赛赛季阶段中，由两支球队对阵并产生比分结果的竞技事件。 Counterexample: 与'赛季/阶段'混淆：后者是比赛所属的时间组织单元，本身不产生对阵与比分。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Match; provenance: direct source Match

name: Player
definition: 以个人身份注册并参加足球比赛的运动员，具有姓名、出生日期、身高、体重等自然属性。 Counterexample: 与'球队'混淆：后者是由多名运动员组成的组织实体，而非自然人。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player; provenance: direct source Player

name: Player_Attributes
definition: 在某一日期对某名运动员各项竞技能力进行量化评估后形成的信息记录，包含综合评分、潜力与多项技术指标。 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：后者是自然人实体，本对象是对其能力在特定时点的评估信息，而非球员本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player_Attributes; provenance: direct source Player_Attributes

name: Team
definition: 由多名运动员组成、以集体身份参加联赛与比赛的竞技组织，具有全称与简称。 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：后者是自然人个体，球队是由个体组成的组织实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team; provenance: direct source Team

name: Team_Attributes
definition: 在某一日期对某支球队进攻组织与防守风格进行量化评估后形成的信息记录，包含速度、传球、射门、压迫等战术指标及其分级。 Counterexample: 与'球队'混淆：后者是组织实体，本对象是对其战术风格在特定时点的评估信息。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team_Attributes; provenance: direct source Team_Attributes

name: HomeTeamGoals
definition: 主队在一场比赛中的进球数

name: AwayTeamGoals
definition: 客队在一场比赛中的进球数

name: Season
definition: 比赛所属的赛季标识

name: CountryName
definition: 联赛所属国家名称

name: LeagueName
definition: 联赛名称

name: MatchDate
definition: 比赛或属性记录的日期

name: BuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: 球队由后场组织进攻的速度评分
aliases: speed in which attacks are put together

name: ChanceCreationPassing
definition: 球队创造机会时的传球评分

name: ChanceCreationPassingClass
definition: 球队创造机会传球评分的等级分类

name: OverallRating
definition: 球员的综合能力评分

name: Potential
definition: 球员的潜力评分

name: PreferredFoot
definition: 球员惯用脚
aliases: prefer to use the right foot
preferred to use their left foots

name: PlayerHeight
definition: 球员身高(厘米)

name: PlayerWeight
definition: 球员体重

name: PlayerBirthday
definition: 球员出生日期

name: HeadingAccuracy
definition: 球员头球准确度评分

name: LongShots
definition: 球员远射能力评分

name: Jumping
definition: 球员弹跳能力评分

name: Finishing
definition: 球员射门终结能力评分

name: Curve
definition: 球员弧线球能力评分

name: Crossing
definition: 球员传中能力评分

name: SprintSpeed
definition: 球员冲刺速度评分
aliases: sprint speed of no less than 97

name: PlayerName
definition: 球员姓名

name: TeamLongName
definition: 球队全称

name: AverageHomeGoals
definition: 场均主队进球数 Formula: SUM(HomeTeamGoals) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal

name: DrawMatchCount
definition: 以平局结束的比赛数 Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN HomeTeamGoals = AwayTeamGoals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal; AwayTeamGoals = Match.away_team_goal

name: AverageHeadingAccuracy
definition: 球员平均头球准确度 Formula: SUM(HeadingAccuracy) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id). Inputs: HeadingAccuracy = Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy

name: AverageLongShots
definition: 球员平均远射评分 Formula: SUM(LongShots) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id). Inputs: LongShots = Player_Attributes.long_shots

name: JumpingDifference
definition: 两名球员弹跳评分之差 Formula: Jumping(player1) - Jumping(player2). Inputs: Jumping = Player_Attributes.jumping

name: UnderweightHeightPercentage
definition: 身高低于180且综合评分高于70的球员占比 Formula: COUNT(PlayerHeight < 180 AND OverallRating > 70) / COUNT(Player.id) * 100. Inputs: PlayerHeight = Player.height; OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating
aliases: percentage of players under 180 cm with overall strength > 7

name: LeftFootPercentage
definition: 惯用左脚球员占比 Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN PreferredFoot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id). Inputs: PreferredFoot = Player_Attributes.preferred_foot
aliases: percentage of players who prefer left foot

name: PlayerAge
definition: 球员当前年龄 Formula: DATETIME() - PlayerBirthday. Inputs: PlayerBirthday = Player.birthday

name: HighestBuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: 球队最高组织进攻速度评分 Formula: MAX(BuildUpPlaySpeed). Inputs: BuildUpPlaySpeed = Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed

name: HighestChanceCreationPassing
definition: 球队最高创造机会传球评分 Formula: MAX(ChanceCreationPassing). Inputs: ChanceCreationPassing = Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassing

name: HighestOverallRating
definition: 球员最高综合评分 Formula: MAX(OverallRating). Inputs: OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating

name: LowestPotential
definition: 球员最低潜力评分 Formula: MIN(Potential). Inputs: Potential = Player_Attributes.potential

name: HighestCrossing
definition: 球员最高传中评分 Formula: MAX(Crossing). Inputs: Crossing = Player_Attributes.crossing

name: HeaviestWeight
definition: 球员最大体重 Formula: MAX(PlayerWeight). Inputs: PlayerWeight = Player.weight

name: PlayerFootPreference
definition: 球员惯用脚分布与相关分析

name: TeamPlayStyleClass
definition: 球队战术风格等级分类

name: MatchStage
definition: 比赛阶段
